nodes.description: msg.sender - externally controlled caller address used for authorization in transferFrom, approve, delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress
Address private owner - privileged account set in constructor to msg.sender and gatekeeper of admin functions
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf - mutable token balances written in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend without SafeMath
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance - mutable spending approvals, decremented in transferFrom
Private mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum - per-address sale counter incremented on each transferFrom and read by condition
Private mapping(address=>bool) canSale - whitelist flag set by _mints and read by ensure to bypass sale conditions
Private uint256 _minSale - minimum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition
Private uint256 _maxSale - maximum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition
Private uint256 _saleNum - maximum number of sales per address set by init and enforced in condition
Address tradeAddress - bypass address set by setTradeAddress and honoured by ensure
Public uint totalSupply - minted in constructor, never adjusted elsewhere
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable - forwards directly to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable - core transfer logic with unchecked balance arithmetic and ensure() gate
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable - writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no return on some paths
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view - privileged bypass checks against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale before condition()
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view - sale limits validation based on _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable - owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker supplied target
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public - privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists via canSale
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public - owner-only setter of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable - owner-only loop distributing balances with unchecked multiplication
setTradeAddress(address addr) public - owner-only setter of the tradeAddress bypass
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure - deterministic Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable - sets owner, totalSupply, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance
Unsafe delegatecall(a.delegatecall(b)) in delegate() - executes arbitrary code in the contract storage context
Unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom (balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; _onSaleNum[_from]++) without SafeMath
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend - potential overflow lets a small balance drain a large batch
Hardcoded privileged address 1132167815322823072539476364451924570945755492656 in _mints grants bypassed minting rights
Parameter _from of transferFrom
Parameter _to of transferFrom
Parameter _value of transferFrom
Parameter a of delegate - attacker controlled delegatecall target
Parameter spender of _mints - credited with minted balance
Parameter addedValue of _mints - raw balance assigned
Parameter _tos of batchSend - recipient array
Parameter _value of batchSend - per-recipient amount
Parameter saleNum of init
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress
Local variable total in batchSend = _value * _tos.length

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer calls transferFrom
msg.sender is compared to _from and used to debit allowance[msg.sender] in transferFrom
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
_mints authorizes on msg.sender==owner || msg.sender==hardcoded address
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) and debits msg.sender balance
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
transfer unconditionally delegates all logic to transferFrom
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked -= and +=
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when caller is not the owner
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to succeed before committing balances
Unchecked balance and sale-counter arithmetic is executed inside transferFrom
ensure short-circuits to true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing sale limits
ensure short-circuits to true when canSale[_from] is set by _mints
ensure short-circuits to true when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted senders
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale count
condition compares _value against _minSale
condition compares _value against _maxSale
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
delegate passes the caller-supplied address a to an unrestricted delegatecall
delegate authorization derives from the owner state variable
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] using a caller-supplied amount
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, whitelisting the address for sale bypass
_mints consults the hardcoded privileged address for authorization
init writes _minSale
init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress bypass used by ensure
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender granting full administrative control
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
_from parameter feeds the balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom
_to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom
_value parameter is subtracted from balances and allowance without SafeMath
parameter a selects the delegatecall target executed by delegate
parameter a is the address on which delegatecall is invoked
spender parameter determines whose balance is overwritten by _mints
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals and assigned to balanceOf[spender]
_tos array supplies per-iteration recipients in batchSend
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited to each recipient
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init

_value of transferFrom is a transient parameter merged into its containing core function
parameter a of delegate is merged into delegate, the core function that consumes it
spender of _mints is merged into the core minting function that uses it
addedValue of _mints is merged into the core minting function that assigns it
_tos of batchSend is merged into the core function iterating it
_value of batchSend is merged into the core function using it
saleNum of init is merged into the core setter function
addr of setTradeAddress is merged into the core setter function
